About half of the tickets for "Ravens X10" have been sold. The game is near the midpoint of its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, a larger share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a good sign.

The numbers for "Ravens X10" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.

809.headline: A close look at the prizes

810.body:
"In the Green" has fewer top prizes left. The count changed when one top prize of $50,000 was claimed two weeks ago. Unsold tickets still hold four of the original seven. Check the top prize count first when you compare scratchers.

Every line of In the Green's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
810.headline: The top prize list got shorter

811.body:
Of the unclaimed prize money on "Extreme Green", about three-quarters is in wins under $5,000. The game is a game that pays many small prizes and few large ones. That is neither good nor bad, only how it was designed. Choose the kind of game that fits the win you want.

The most common prize left on "Extreme Green" right now is $20.

Everything here about "Extreme Green" comes from official Maryland lottery numbers, current through November 13.

814.headline: Early stage or late

815.body:

Every line of $100,000 Crossword's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
815.headline: Top prize count went down

816.body:
"Deluxe Crossword" can match another game on price and top prize and still pay out very differently. This game is a game that pays many small prizes and few large ones. Of its unclaimed prize money, nearly all is in wins under $1,000 and the rest is in bigger prizes. Neither kind is better, and each suits different players.

Every line of Deluxe Crossword's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.

818.headline: How far along this game is

819.body:
The prize money on "30X Cash" leans toward small, frequent prizes. It is spread over eight prize levels, from wins equal to the ticket price up to $30,000. Games built like this give out wins often, but rarely large ones. That design never changes, and it is the part you choose.

If you play "30X Cash" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.

822.body:
The most common win left on "Peppermint Payout" is $3. The second biggest prize left is $600, and 84 of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

Everything above about "Peppermint Payout" comes from the Maryland Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
